technical.summary: Extreme oversold conditions with isolated supertrend support, but severe short-term bearish structure, negative momentum, and lack of bullish confirmation make this a low-probability entry despite potential mean-reversion setup.

fundamental.summary: No insider buying, no institutional signal, no government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 23 days create a weak fundamental setup with elevated event risk.

sentiment.summary: Weak congressional selling pressure combined with extreme fear sentiment (33/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, though lack of news data limits conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (379.5) with imminent FOMC event in 2 days creates severe near-term volatility risk; earnings in 23 days adds secondary binary event risk; yield curve normal but macro_score of -3 signals broad deterioration.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme RSI oversold (9 and 14) with supertrend bullish support and contrarian fear-zone sentiment (33/100) offer classic mean-reversion setup near support level 22.7717.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (VIX crisis 379.5, FOMC in 2 days, earnings in 23 days), complete absence of bullish momentum confirmation (all MAs bearish, MACD negative, no crossovers, OBV flat, CMF negative), and price below all key moving averages create unacceptable near-term volatility and event risk that overwhelms oversold technicals.

decision.entry_rationale: Extreme RSI oversold (9/14) with supertrend support and fear-zone sentiment offer theoretical mean-reversion setup, but macro crisis regime (VIX 379.5, FOMC in 2 days) and complete absence of bullish momentum confirmation make near-term execution unacceptably risky.
